content_sections.heading: MbPA Jr. Professional Intern Recruitment 2026 - Overview

Finance Department, Mumbai Port Authority, Mumbai

Below 35 years (as on the date of advertisement)

content_sections.heading: MbPA Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. FA/E/PS-I/F.1065/2469 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download MbPA notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Other conditions: Proficiency in MS Office Working knowledge of ERP/SAP Excellent verbal and written communication skills Should be in good health Must have own laptop A candidate can apply for engagement only once during a financial year Desirable: Minimum 3 years' experience in relevant field supported by field work/ policy papers/ appraisal and monitoring of projects & schemes

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for MbPA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates not fulfilling eligibility conditions; applications shall be rejected No relaxation in any of qualifications or experience

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initial engagement of 2 years, extendable by additional 2 years with 2 day break on performance, no further extension Performance review after every 6 months Full time; no other assignment permitted during engagement Termination by one month notice or proportionate remuneration; intern must give one month notice No experience certificate if less than 1 year completed Sign Integrity Pact (Annexure III) with MbPA

content_sections.heading: How Will MbPA Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Scrutiny and shortlisting of applications on qualification, experience and other details Test/interview etc. for shortlisted candidates, if called Applications scrutinized and shortlisted in the light of qualification, experience and other details in the application form Shortlisted candidates may be called for test/ interview etc. before selection Original certificates to be produced for verification at the time of interview No TA/DA for appearing in written examination/interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of certificates relating to age/qualification Proof of educational qualification, age, experience and address proof Passport size photograph affixed on the form No Objection Certificate from employer, for candidates serving in Government/Semi Government/PSUs/Autonomous Bodies Documents for any outstanding achievement mentioned

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MbPA Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download the application format (Annexure-I) from www.mumbaiport.gov.in ('People & Career/Jobs' menu). Fill the application format with the required details and declaration. Enclose proof of educational qualification, age, experience and address proof. Superscribe the envelope 'Application for engagement of Jr. Professional Intern on contract basis'. Send it to Financial Adviser & Chief Accounts Officer, Mumbai Port Authority, Port Bhavan, Gr. floor, S. V. Marg, Ballard Estate, Mumbai - 400001 before 15.12.2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Updates and corrigenda only on www.mumbaiport.gov.in under 'People & Career > Jobs' menu Mere CV/resume or incomplete applications will be rejected Applications received after the due date liable to be rejected Indicate percentage of marks; convert CGPA as per the university's criteria Selected candidates must produce original mark sheets, character certificate and self-declaration certificate at joining Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MbPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MbPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 vacancies for Jr. Professional Intern.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for MbPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-I of the notice, also on www.mumbaiport.gov.in ('People & Career/Jobs' menu)) and send it to Financial Adviser & Chief Accounts Officer, Mumbai Port Authority, Port Bhavan, Gr. floor, S. V. Marg, Ballard Estate, Mumbai - 400001, by by post to the address in the notice, in a superscribed envelope, to reach by 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 35 years (as on the date of advertisement).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Consolidated Rs. 40,000 per month, with annual increments of 5% on satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com) from any recognized University/College/Institution in India.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Proficiency in MS Office. Working knowledge of ERP/SAP. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Should be in good health.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates not fulfilling eligibility conditions; applications shall be rejected. No relaxation in any of qualifications or experience.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny and shortlisting of applications on qualification, experience and other details. Test/interview etc. for shortlisted candidates, if called. Applications scrutinized and shortlisted in the light of qualification, experience and other details in the application form. Shortlisted candidates may be called for test/ interview etc. before selection.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initial engagement of 2 years, extendable by additional 2 years with 2 day break on performance, no further extension. Performance review after every 6 months. Full time; no other assignment permitted during engagement.
